- get_deployment_response_dashboard: Get private signed url to dashboard"

Once that's done, create a Production-Overview dashboard using role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/DashboardAccess and external ID ext-id-secure-123 that refreshes every 5 minutes and notify ops-team@company.com with the link.
